products.mission: In-app concierge for search, help, and SMARTviews.
Patron connections and chat after both people accept.
Paid LED messages at a venue.
Venue pickup requests when the club and account allow RydR.
Live phone camera to the venue floqCast board on display2.
Table holds and deposits where a club is subscribed.
Virtual sets from FloqMedia Spatial Studio grants.
Named in the Features SMARTview kit. No product page or feature key in this repository.

features.title: Conversational concierge
features.shortDescription: Signed-in patrons can chat with BOT DEE on botdee.html for help, search, and SMARTviews.
features.accomplishment: Gives a single in-app place to ask how FLOQR products work.
features.patronBenefit: You do not have to hunt through admin docs for basic how-tos.
features.currentBehavior: Satellite chat reuses the Search session. Feature key botDee is packaged Enabled + Test.
features.verificationNotes: Packaged featureServices/botDee {1,1}. Live Firestore flags were not read this run. Pages hosts botdee.html on main.

sourceEvidence.note: Packaged catalog row botDee IsFeatureEnabled 1 IsTestFeature 1

history.note: Code on main; live audience not verified

features.title: Version SMARTview
features.shortDescription: Ver / Vers / Version opens a Version SMARTview card with live package stamps — not Features SMARTview.
features.accomplishment: Shows honest service status for BOT DEE and Gemini on this request.
features.patronBenefit: You can check which package this chat is on without a six-phase dump.
features.currentBehavior: Alias replies are card-only. What's New on that card is BOT DEE/Gemini notes only.
features.verificationNotes: Distinct from Features SMARTview. Do not list Master Admin tools on Version What's New.

features.title: People SMARTview
features.shortDescription: Who is / What do you know of questions mount public-within-FLOQR People cards.
features.accomplishment: Looks up people by identity fields only (name, handle), not bios.
features.patronBenefit: You see the same public profile media as the public page, not a second profile.
features.currentBehavior: PR #141 merged identity-only scoring. Merged date is not a patron-availability date.
features.verificationNotes: Merged PR is not proof Functions were deployed from that SHA.

features.title: Room SMARTview

features.accomplishment: Invited Mingl friends can join a BOT DEE session. Join is not a payment.
